{{Quote|Get to your ships and evacuate!|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], ordering his Death Watch troops to board their ''Kom'rk''-class fighters|<ref name="TMP" />}}
The '''''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport''', also called '''Gauntlet starfighter''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed by rogue members of the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] corporation for use by the violent [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter-group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Taking its name from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word for "[[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]]," Death Watch's leader by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], owned a ''Kom'rk''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which he named [[Gauntlet (Pre Vizsla)/Legends|''Gauntlet'']], and made use of as his personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Over fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and equipped with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and powerful [[Engine/Legends|engines]], each ''Kom'rk'' model was an able assault craft and fighter.

Several ''Kom'rk'' fighters were stationed at the [[Death Watch hideout|Death Watch's hideout]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. During a [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|confrontation]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars, Vizsla ordered his Death Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to evacuate [[Concordian mines/Legends|the area]] aboard their ''Kom'rk''-class fighters. However, the Death Watch returned to their base shortly after, bringing their ''Kom'rk'' fighters with them, waiting in preparation for a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-backed conquest of Mandalore that was [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|delayed]] due to the efforts of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Later, after having been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|driven]] from the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], Death Watch relocated to the frigid world of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] with their ''Kom'rk'' fighters, where the transports ringed [[Carlac Death Watch camp/Legends|their camp]].

Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the Death Watch's ''Kom'rk''-class transports came across an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] over [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] containing the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The fighter docked with the pod, and its crew recovered the injured [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], returning with them to the Death Watch's [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|encampment]] on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]]. There, an [[Shadow Collective/Legends|alliance]] was formed between Death Watch and the Sith, and they set out to collect further allies among [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]], [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|storming]] the Black Sun [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|base]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and the [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|hall]] of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with [[Troop/Legends|troops]] launched from their ''Kom'rk'' fighters.

==Characteristics==
===Dimensions===
[[File:GauntletFighter-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Gauntlet (Pre Vizsla)/Legends|''Gauntlet'']], a modified ''Kom'rk'']]
The ''Kom'rk''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]/[[Transport/Legends|transport]] came in at least two models.<ref name="Etrivia" /> One was 68.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, with broad, angular,<ref name="TCWIV" /> rotating wings.<ref name="TCWEGS">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> The other was 52.3 meters long.<ref name="Etrivia" /><ref name="GauntletFighter" />

The ''Kom'rk''-class's wings alternated between an upright landing position when grounded, and a horizontal configuration while flying in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] or [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TMP" /> While in flight, the wings could also rotate around the vessel's main body, allowing for increased maneuverability.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Mandalore Plot">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode212.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>

===Offensive and defensive systems===
Designed and built by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company, [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], the ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport shared several of these design aspects with MandalMotors' [[Aka'jor-class shuttle/Legends|''Aka'jor''-class shuttle]]. Unlike the unarmed [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''Kom'rk''-class fighter was equipped with twin, forward-facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] located at the nose of the main body.<ref name="TCWIV" /> On the larger model, each gun barrel stood on the end of the vessel's forward prongs.<ref name="TMP" /> On the smaller model, they were tucked in-between the prongs.<ref name="Etrivia" />

===Propulsion systems===
The starship featured two rear [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for propulsion;<ref name="TMP" /> these turbojets were designed to allow for rapid engine start-up.<ref name="TCWIV" />

===Complement===
The ship possessed a troop bay in the main section. A hatch on the ventral surface of the ship could open and allowed 24 warriors to be deployed into battle quickly. The Death Watch made great use of this feature, deploying their jetpack-equipped soldiers while the ship was still airborne, allowing for extremely fast raids on targets.<ref name="Eminence" />

==Role==
An able [[Troop/Legends|troop]] transport,<ref name="TMP" /> keeping with its official classification by its MandalMotors creators, the ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport also had little trouble living up to the second aspect of its name: fighter. Crewed by up to four beings, the ''Kom'rk''{{'s}} small size, its twin laser cannon armament, and its significant maneuverability, made the starship an effective assault craft.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==History==
[[File:Death_Watch_Hideout.png|thumb|right|250px|''Kom'rk''-class fighters resting in landing configuration at the Death Watch's [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]] base]]
At some point in [[Time/Legends|time]], prior to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> the ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport was designed and built for the radical Mandalorian splinter-group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] by rogue elements within MandalMotors,<ref name="TCWIV" /> a prominent Mandalorian starship company and driving force behind the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] economy,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> headquartered in planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> By the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], numerous ''Kom'rk''-class fighters had entered into the possession of the Death Watch. Their most recent leader, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] of Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]],<ref name="TMP" /> possessed a ''Kom'rk'' which he named [[Gauntlet (Pre Vizsla)/Legends|''Gauntlet'']],<ref name="TVB">{{WebCite|url=http://programme.tvb.com/kids/starwarstheclonewars2/more/vehicle|text=Star Wars The Clone Wars (II)|work=TVB.com|archivedate=20100129080303}}</ref> the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] [[Language/Legends|language]] translation of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''kom'rk''.<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

At the Death Watch's [[Death Watch hideout|secret base]] among the abandoned [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Concordian mines/Legends|mines of Concordia]]<ref name="NewBattlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> the Mandalorian renegades kept a number of ''Kom'rk''-class fighters. These ''Kom'rk'' fighters were used to evacuate the base of its [[Troop/Legends|troops]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|discovered]] the Death Watch, on the orders of the sect's leader, Pre Vizsla. While his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] boarded their vessels, and the ''Kom'rk'' transports lifted off and away from the [[Mining/Legends|mines]], Vizsla [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaged]] Kenobi in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|single combat]], managing to overcome the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with the aid of a trio of his [[Gender/Legends|men]].<ref name="TMP" /> However, once the Jedi had fled, Vizsla and his Death Watch [[Army/Legends|army]] soon returned, and brought their ''Kom'rk'' fighters with them. There, the vessels and their owners waited for the order to begin an attack Vizsla promised would allow the Death Watch to take control of Mandalore and destroy the dominance of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|government]]. That order never came, due to the efforts of the New Mandalorians' [[Duke/Legends|leader]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], who was able to halt the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic military]] [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|occupation]] that the Death Watch would need to justify their actions in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the Mandalorian people.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MandieFighter.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The ''Kom'rk''-class fighter featured wings that rotated in multiple configurations.]]
The ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode, ''[[The Mandalore Plot]]'', originally aired on [[January 29]], [[2010]]. Used briefly by the Death Watch troops, the fighter would again feature in the episode ''[[Duchess of Mandalore]]'', again in a mostly background role. The ship's name was never featured in either episode, but revealed through the reference book, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''. Further details, including the starship's manufacturer and other statistics, came with the release of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' guidebook. It was designed by concept artist [[Thang Le]].
